en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  The  Holy  Prophet  (s.a.w.s.)  said,  “Keep away  from  the doors  of the king  and his  confidants  because as a  person goes  near  them,  he  goes  far  from  Allah.  A  person  who considers the king more important than Allah will continue to lose piety and remain confused and perplexed.”
